header: Many quotes in one scrolling row
lead: A scroll-snap row that works without a script: drag, swipe or use the arrow keys. The next card peeks in at the edge.

quotes.quote_text: Two to sixteen quotes. The arrow buttons are for mouse users and are disabled at the start and end.
quotes.author: The first card

image.alternative: Portrait of a woman in her fifties.

quotes.quote_text: Below 768 pixels the arrows are hidden. On a phone they would cover the cards, and swiping works better.
quotes.author: The second card

image.alternative: Portrait of a man in his fifties.

quotes.quote_text: The script only adds the arrow buttons. Scrolling, snapping and keyboard use come from the browser.
quotes.author: The third card

image.alternative: Portrait of a woman in her thirties.

quotes.quote_text: The name sits at the bottom of every card, so names line up however long the quotes are.
quotes.author: The fourth card

image.alternative: Portrait of a man in his forties.
